verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API with session discovery, token auth, and RFC-based specifications, but nothing in the evidence identifies an official Fastmail SDK. The Rust and TypeScript libraries are listed only on the open-standard jmap.io site and are not shown to be Fastmail-provided SDKs. A raw protocol API plus ecosystem libraries is a building block, not the official-SDK capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
